_doc: Indicators per index component. direction +1: higher value = better score; -1: lower is better. weight: within its component. goalposts [lo, hi]: absolute scoring range (0 at the bad end, 100 at the good end). log: compare ln(1+x). missing_as_worst: a missing value scores 0. source: core (computed from FollowMe GPS + RTL timetable + airports + census; passenger = speedboats incl. RTL ferries, goods = dhoni/slow) or a CSV in indexes/extra/ keyed by island code; per_1000 divides by population. enabled false = defined, waiting for data.
